structure_unknown_policy: Original counts stay at their observed scope and date. Compatible opening pools use model allocations. Other pools retain unknown age and sex.

opening_age_sex_by_scope.note: Opening controls before named-resident deductions. Source-age-unknown cells remain unknown after integer apportionment. Dated census populations are separate. Unknown research regions do not inherit a continent from political control.

opening_count_basis.note: Published historical estimates include the normalized date of a research or contemporary estimate. Territorial models use census or official statistical returns at other dates. No census exactly matches the opening date and scope. Residents without an exclusive opening count remain in the geography and benchmark ledgers; the difference between authorities is not an observed count of missing residents.
